verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents automated control testing against integrated systems, with continuous daily monitoring and email alerts to admins when tests fail or their status changes. That surfaces failing controls well before an annual audit, and a daily cadence plausibly meets 'within hours'. missing for 10: an explicitly documented sub-daily or hourly test cadence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of alert latency.

support.subject: As a security engineer, automated tests run continuously against my connected systems — failing controls surface within hours, not at the annual audit

citations.quote: Continuous daily monitoring of your compliance status with alerts for failing tests.
Admins receive proactive email notifications when tests require attention or test statuses are changed.
automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Secureframe seamlessly syncs with hundreds of the tools you're already using to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring.
Continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations across your technology stack.
